name: ev_charging_cost
title: EV charging cost per 100 km and break-even with fuel cars
description: What 100 km costs in an electric car at a given price per kWh, and the electricity price at which it costs the same as a petrol or diesel car. Fuel cars to compare with are Germany's most registered new models of 2025 with real-world consumption, plus an optional own car. All inputs are URL query parameters, so a filled-in link reproduces the view.
formula: ev_cost_per_100km = kwh_per_100km * (1 + loss / 100) * p; fuel_cost_per_100km = litres_per_100km * fuel_price; break_even_p = fuel_cost_per_100km / (kwh_per_100km * (1 + loss / 100))

car.description: Electric car name: a built-in car or any electric model in the official catalog (name field of https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/de/electric.json). Without lv, the levels are 0.9, 1, 1.22 and 1.38 times the official WLTP kWh/100 km (the same figure the car page and Compare use); the built-in estimates in calc.js only apply when the catalog is unavailable.

lv.description: Four consumption levels in kWh/100 km, comma separated: efficient, typical, motorway 120 km/h, winter. Default: from the car's official WLTP figure (Volvo EX30: 17.2).

use.description: Which level the answer uses: 0 efficient, 1 typical, 2 motorway, 3 winter.

loss.description: Charging losses between plug and battery.

petrol.description: Petrol price. Defaults to the latest German average (EU Weekly Oil Bulletin when available, else ADAC monthly average).

diesel.description: Diesel price, same source as petrol.

refs.description: Fuel cars to compare with, comma separated ids.

own.description: Your own fuel car as litres_per_100km,fuel, for example 6.2,petrol or 5.5,diesel. Omit for none.

evp.description: Cost over the years: electric car price before the grant.

grant.description: Cost over the years: E-Auto grant. Defaults to the amount from the grant check saved on this device, else 0. See https://cars.allo.land/ev-grant/

fcp.description: Cost over the years: price of the fuel car (the first one compared: your own car, else the first of refs).

km.description: Cost over the years: kilometres a year.

yrs.description: Cost over the years: how many years.

ccm.description: Cost over the years: fuel car engine size for the vehicle tax, with co2 and tc. Built-in fuel cars have their own figures.

co2.description: Cost over the years: fuel car official CO2 (WLTP) for the vehicle tax.

tc.description: Cost over the years: id of the fuel car that ccm and co2 belong to (own or a refs id).

cost_over_years.formula: total_after_n_years = price (EV: minus grant) + n * (km / 100 * cost_per_100km + vehicle_tax); payback_years = (ev_price - grant - fuel_car_price) / yearly saving
cost_over_years.vehicle_tax: Kfz-Steuer for cars first registered from 2021: 2 EUR (petrol) or 9.50 EUR (diesel) per started 100 cm3, plus 2.00 to 4.00 EUR per g CO2/km above 95. Electric cars first registered by 2030 pay none for up to ten years, until 2035 at the latest.
cost_over_years.not_included: insurance, servicing, tyres, financing, resale value

fuel_cars.golf: VW Golf 1.5 TSI, petrol, 6.5 L/100 km
fuel_cars.troc: VW T-Roc 1.5 TSI, petrol, 7.0 L/100 km
fuel_cars.tiguan: VW Tiguan 2.0 TDI, diesel, 6.5 L/100 km
fuel_cars.octavia: Skoda Octavia 2.0 TDI, diesel, 5.3 L/100 km
fuel_cars.passat: VW Passat 2.0 TDI, diesel, 5.8 L/100 km
fuel_cars.cx30: Mazda CX-30 2.5 e-Skyactiv G, petrol, 7.0 L/100 km
fuel_cars.cx5: Mazda CX-5 2.5 e-Skyactiv G, petrol, 7.8 L/100 km

sources.fuel_car_models: KBA new registrations 2025 by model series, plus Mazda CX-30 and CX-5
sources.fuel_car_consumption: Real-world averages rounded from owner logs on spritmonitor.de
sources.fuel_prices: https://cars.allo.land/data/fuel-prices/latest.json (European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin, CC BY 4.0); fallback ADAC monthly average October 2026
sources.ev_official_consumption: https://cars.allo.land/data/vehicle-catalog/de/electric.json (EEA CO2 monitoring of new cars: WLTP kWh/100 km at the plug, registration-weighted, CC BY 4.0)

legacy_parameters: fl (L/100 km) and fp (EUR/L) from older links become own=fl,petrol and petrol=fp.
